label: Borrower name as supplied
definition: Literal name supplied by the source for the borrower associated with the mapped record. This field does not certify the legal name or establish that similar names identify the same entity.
notes: Map only after confirming the source role. Keep borrower IDs, guarantor names, facility names and reporting context separate. Text cleanup proposes representations; it does not merge entities or loan rows.

label: Borrower address as supplied
definition: Literal source address explicitly associated with the borrower. The source role and address convention must be reviewed; a shared address alone does not establish borrower identity.

label: Borrower identifier as supplied
definition: Literal borrower identifier in an explicitly established source namespace. Preserve leading zeroes and punctuation. Never substitute a loan, facility, tranche, holding or reporting identifier.

label: Facility name as supplied
definition: Literal descriptive name supplied by the source for the facility associated with the mapped record. This field is separate from facility identifiers, tranche identifiers and borrower identity.
notes: A shared facility label does not establish that loans, tranches, positions or reporting dates are interchangeable. Preserve identifiers and rows separately.
